raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Capgemini Mumbai Oct 2024 – Jul 2026 Associate ▪ Managed end-to-end corporate actions lifecycle including dividends, amendments, fund setup, and ISIN
creation across 4 European markets (AT, DE, CH, LI) with high accuracy and SLA adherence.
▪ Led daily allocations and workflow prioritization for multi-market event processing, improving turnaround time
and reducing operational delays.
▪ Managed and maintained client and entity reference data, validating mandatory attributes and ensuring
accurate, complete and consistent information across operational system
▪ Supported creation and maintenance of client hierarchies by validating entity relationships and ensuring
accurate mapping of clients, accounts and related reference data within operational systems.
▪ Managed and validated client settlement instructions (Static SSI), ensuring accuracy and completeness of settlement
account details and coordinating with relevant teams for timely system updates.
▪ Performed monthly and quarterly reconciliations of financial statements and transaction records, identifying
discrepancies and strengthening process controls.
▪ Collaborated with Poland-based global teams and clients to resolve issues efficiently and improve
stakeholder confidence.
▪ Delivered QA/QC reviews, defect identification, and root cause analysis to improve process accuracy and
reduce repeat errors.
▪ Trained and onboarded new associates, improving ramp-up speed and team productivity. ▪ Coordinated with clients and global stakeholders to validate information, resolve discrepancies and ensure
timely completion of time-sensitive operational deliverables
Hapag Lloyd L7 Coordinator ▪ Tracked shipments and containers based on client requests while maintaining SLA-driven communication. ▪ Prepared and maintained accurate reports and records to support operational transparency. ▪ Handled client communication through email and followed defined process and escalation guidelines.
Mumbai Oct 2022 – Aug 2023
